Row.Text: Culture becomes a living field that spreads from your cities tile by tile. A strong, established culture slowly grows its borders beyond the normal city footprint, seeps into open land, and can flip a rival's frontier tiles once your culture there decisively wins - a systemic answer to AI forward-settling. Growth is slow and organic: borders creep outward over the game and flow back when a culture weakens; an overwhelming culture reaches farther. A reimagining and extension of the Civ V mod Cultural Diffusion, rebuilt for Civ VII, with a deeper cultural-power model and optional Emigration integration. Single-player, tunable (Low/Medium/High), reversible. Works standalone, and reads diaspora data from the Emigration mod when it is installed.
How aggressively culture spreads your borders. Low nudges into empty land only; Medium contests rival frontier tiles; High spreads farther and flips faster.
Master switch. When off, borders behave exactly as in the base game.
Cultural Diffusion - claim empty land only
Safety mode. Diffusion claims only unowned frontier plots and never flips a tile owned by another civilization.

How deep culture may push into a rival's city. Full downtown ring keeps their center and its inner ring safe. Center only protects just the city-center tile, letting culture take the tiles around it. None lets even the center flip.
Protect city center only (take inner tiles)

On (recommended): culture only claims tiles touching your land, so a rival's territory is taken from the outside in. Off: culture may claim any tile it dominates, including a disconnected pocket inside another civilization.

Drive border spread with a civilization's whole cultural power - wonders, culture, influence, happiness, prosperity, traditions - not culture-per-turn alone. A stronger culture pushes its borders farther. Off = the simple settlement-culture model.
When the Emigration mod is installed, let a frontier tile settled by your people feel your pull - borders follow diaspora. No effect if Emigration is absent. Requires the rich cultural model.
Write detailed per-pass diagnostics to UI.log (for tuning and troubleshooting).
